name: Short Cut Shrimp Ramen with Mixed Veggies, Egg & Spicy Chili Crisp

ingredients.name: frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, sugar snap peas, water chestnuts)
instant ramen noodle soup, shrimp flavor

instructions.primary_message: Place hot water (from the tap) in a large pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water is boiling, add veggies and noodles (reserving flavor packets). Stir to combine the soup and cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles and veggies are soft, 3-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (10.8 oz) bag frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, sugar snap peas, water chestnuts)
2 (3 oz) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, shrimp flavor

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp and stir to combine. Continue to cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 8 oz cooked shrimp, peeled, tail off

instructions.primary_message: Remove soup from heat, add flavor packets, and stir until combined.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Halve eggs and add to the bowls, then drizzle with chili crisp. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp chili crisp (spicy chili pepper condiment)
